title: On covariance estimation of non-synchronously observed diffusion processes
finding: Synchronization and interpolation can distort covariance. Equation 3.1 sums products of increments whose observation intervals overlap; its diffusion and sampling assumptions are not established for target crypto trades.
Institutional metadata corroborates Bernoulli 11(2), 359-379 and DOI 10.3150/bj/1116340299.
